name: webex-mcp
description: Query and manage Webex Admin, Calling, Contact Center, Devices, Meetings, and Messaging via natural language.
long_description: Requires the Webex CLI to be installed and authenticated (webex login). Install via: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Cloverhound/webex-cli/main/install.sh | sh

tools.name: webex_read
tools.description: Execute a read-only Webex CLI command (list, get, download, export) — maps to GET API calls

tools.name: webex_write
tools.description: Execute a Webex CLI command that creates, updates, or deletes a resource — maps to POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE

tools.name: webex_help
tools.description: Get help text for any Webex CLI command or command group
